# Retained Public Plonk Fixture

B-0031 writes one approved synthetic Plonk fixture into `retained-plonk-v1/`.
The directory contains only a public zero-knowledge proof, its public journal,
public verification-key identifiers, checksums, and proof-run provenance.

Do not place a witness, private snapshot, relationship path, Merkle opening, salt,
caveat value, private journal input, or debug trace in this directory.
